en.topic_title: Typhoon Bavi makes landfall in China as death toll in Philippines rises to 18
en.topic_summary:
Typhoon Bavi was downgraded to a severe tropical storm Sunday after making landfall in eastern China, where authorities had evacuated nearly two million people in its path.



Strong waves break along the coast in Yilan on July 10, 2026, as Typhoon Bavi moves toward Northeastern Taiwan. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng /  AFP.



There were no immediate reports of damage or casualties.
